# Copilot Instructions

Read `.agent/directives/AGENT.md`, `.agent/directives/rules.md`, and
`.agent/practice-index.md` (all relative to the repo root) to understand the
project, the agent's role, and the repo's live tooling surfaces.

If you are touching agent tooling or platform adapters, also read
`.agent/reference/cross-platform-agent-surface-matrix.md`.
